biggest_catch: Paid studies are typically in-person only on the CMU campus in Pittsburgh - the participant page asks that only Pittsburgh residents request an account.
catches: Paid studies typically in-person only on the Carnegie Mellon campus; pool asks that only Pittsburgh residents request an account
Study availability is irregular - researchers post studies throughout the year
Three unexcused no-shows (no 24h cancellation) results in a ban of at least three months
Payment is distributed by individual researchers, not the pool itself - timing/method varies
Credit studies (course credit) and paid studies are separate; make sure you sign up for paid ones

eligibility: CMU students (graduate/undergraduate) and Pittsburgh-area residents; paid studies open to both students and the general Pittsburgh community
notes: Standing Research Participation Pool of CMU's Center for Behavioral and Decision Research (pool created 2026 per the participant page). payout_quote: At minimum, studies must compensate $10 per 1 hour of study participation, in increments of $5 and 30 minutes, rounding up (e.g., a 45-minute study should compensate $10). Studies may compensate participants up to $15 per 1 hour of research.
payout_value_note: Hourly rate bounds from the pool's official compensation policy (minimum $10/hr, maximum $15/hr per hour of participation).

steps: Request an account on the CMU Research Participation Pool (Pittsburgh residents)
Browse posted paid studies (credit studies are separate - choose paid ones)
Sign up for a paid study slot
Attend the in-person session on the Carnegie Mellon campus on time
Receive compensation from the researcher ($10-$15 per hour of participation)
timing: Compensation disbursed by the individual researcher per study; timing and method vary.
